chunks: From him, from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab, from Ghiyath ibn Kallub ibn Fayhas al-Bajali, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Ja'far, from his father, peace be upon them:
That Ali, peace be upon him, used to say:
“Whoever learns anything of magic, his final covenant with his Lord is broken, and his prescribed punishment is execution, unless he repents.”
And he used to say: “The prescribed punishments are not to be carried out in the land of the enemy, out of fear that zeal may overtake him and he may then join the land of the enemy.”

key_terms.آخِرَ عَهْدِهِ بِرَبِّهِ: the severing of one's final bond or covenant with his Lord
key_terms.الْحَمِيَّةُ: tribal or emotional zeal that may provoke rash action
key_terms.الْحُدُودُ: the prescribed penal punishments in sacred law

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali عليه السلام say about learning magic and carrying out hudud in enemy territory?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits two legal rulings from Imam Ali عليه السلام. The first concerns the grave ruling regarding learning magic, while the second concerns suspending the implementation of hudud in enemy territory due to the risk of defection and harmful consequences.
